title: Verify: BootScene plays character animation on playAnimation unit tests
summary: Unit tests for playAnimation dispatch with Phaser mocked
description: Test that playAnimation drives sprite.play for known targets and is ignored for unknown targets.
acceptance_criteria: interact and idle emit tests assert play keys
Unknown target test asserts no extra play
technical_constraints: Mock phaser and ../src/runtime/content as in tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts

steps.action: Copy the phaser and content vi.mock setup from tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts; capture the sprite returned by scene.add.sprite; call create(); then reactToPhaser.emit('playAnimation', {target:'boy', name:'interact'}) and assert sprite.play was last called with 'boy-sheet:interact' style key from the mocked manifest; emit name 'idle' and assert idle key; emit target 'ghost' and assert play call count unchanged. Reset with reactToPhaser.clear() in beforeEach.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScenePlayAnimation.test.ts
